text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace triumphed in the Japanese 
Derby. Meanwhile, the spectators buzzed 
with excitement watching Mr. C.B.'s run, 
convinced she was a prodigy destined to 
surpass the "Myth."

Mr. C.B. explains that while losing 
stings, she enjoyed the race more than 
anything else.

She is thrilled to learn that the 
pre-debut Symboli Rudolf is already 
drawing attention, imagining how much she 
will transform over the course of a year.

Meanwhile, despite her victory, Katsuragi 
Ace was frustrated to see the crowd 
fixated entirely on Mr. C.B., feeling like 
she had just been treated as a stepping 
stone.

Mr. C.B.'s next goal is the final leg of 
the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho.
